item.title: St. Mary Foundation awards grants to nonprofits
item.description: Submitted photos Court Appointed Special Advocates, top photo, and the Bring Foster the Love to St. Mary Foster Families Initiative, bottom photo, were among the six nonprofits receiving St. Mary Foundation grants this year. The St. Mary Foundation, an affiliate of Community Foundation of Acadiana, announced $30,000 in grants to six St. Mary Parish nonprofit organizations.

item.title: Deadline approaches for Medicare options
item.description: An opportunity to customize Medicare benefits for 2026 ends Sunday, Dec. 7, and if you miss the deadline, you will likely have to wait a full year before you can make a change to your plan.

item.title: Patterson moves to secure grant for water plant
item.description: Patterson Mayor Rodney Grogan said Tuesday, during the city's last meeting of 2025, that 2026 will bring a lot of replacement orders as the city contends with its aging water pipes. The Review/Howard J. Castay PATTERSON — City leaders are crossing their fingers that a revised application, coupled with a resolution they passed Tuesday, will seal the deal on added improvements to its water plant.

item.title: Conrad, Samsung agree to work together in LNG bunkering market
item.description: Conrad Shipyard executive Johnny Conrad and Joonyun Kang, director of Samsung's Eco Business Team, sign a memorandum of understanding under which the companies will work together in the LNG bunkering market. Conrad Shipyard photo Morgan City’s Conrad Shipyard LLC and Samsung Heavy Industries Co. Ltd., another leading shipbuilder, have agreed to work together in LNG bunkering.
